about.title: 🌟 About Me
paragraphs: Hello! I am Han Xiao (肖汉), Associate Professor at [Ocean University of China](https://www.ouc.edu.cn/).
My research lies at the intersection of combinatorial optimization and algorithmic game theory, with a primary focus on the following areas:

points.label: Combinatorial Optimization
points.description: Algorithm design and computational complexity for discrete optimization problems such as network flows, matchings, and covering.

points.label: Algorithmic Game Theory
points.description: Computational complexity of game equilibria, and approximation guarantees for system efficiency under selfish behavior.

points.label: Polyhedral Combinatorics
points.description: Polyhedral structure of combinatorial optimization problems, such as linear programming relaxations and cutting-plane methods.

about.note: 📬 Please feel free to send me an email if you are interested in discussing or working together. My email is [hxiao@ouc.edu.cn](mailto:hxiao@ouc.edu.cn)!
